scope: All four current conclusions are checked. The sharp weighted cut bound already holds for arbitrary integrable kernels, and the literal edge/triangle counting bounds are combined. Classical compactness through vertex maps and ordinary L1 approximation by bijections now yield genuine bijective subsequence representatives with actual cut-norm convergence; this selection/convergence step is proved internally. The infimum, symmetry, triangle inequality and zero distance under arbitrary preserving pullbacks are proved on the stronger domain of arbitrary integrable real kernels. On graphons the new infimum is definitionally the existing cut distance.
